utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want the drop-off spot, or should I give you the next stop on the list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Let’s do the next stop on the list — I’m heading to the community hall now, so we can sort the timing there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — let’s meet at the community hall first, and then we’ll sort out the repair drive timing from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll be at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll swing by with the tools soon, and we can sort the repair drive timing at the hall.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please list the jobs and send a couple of time options. Saturday at 10 a.m. still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send the job list and a couple of time options. Saturday at 10 a.m. is set for me too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with setup or carrying stuff — just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll pass that along and we’ll sort the repair drive timing at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could we lock in the community hall drop-off time first? Once that’s set, I can sort the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah—can you confirm the repair drive is still on? I’m just trying to keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s meet at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That works for me — I can come by the community hall, and I’ll keep my part quiet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, and what’s already been checked so far?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The repair drive is the one we moved to Sunday at the community center, and the timing’s the main thing left to keep lined up. If you want, I can catch you up on what’s already been set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, it’s still on — I’m just getting the last details sorted and keeping everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — I’m still a bit behind, but I can help with setup or carrying stuff. Just let me know what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can keep track of supplies—what do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Rey — that’s a big help. I’ll check what we still need and let you know so we can fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks — I’m just keeping track of what’s still missing for the neighborhood repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That makes sense — I’m still keeping it low-key and organized, and I can help note what’s missing if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — the drop-off spot is the community center loading entrance on Maple. If you want, I can also tell you the next place on the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — the community center loading entrance on Maple, got it. And yes, if you’ve got the next place, I’d appreciate that too.
